troubleshooter.explain.missing-condition.message: This filter has no search conditions. Add conditions, disable it or delete it if it is no longer needed.

troubleshooter.explain.missing-folder.message: A move or copy action points to a folder that is missing or cannot receive messages. Select an existing destination in the filter editor.

troubleshooter.explain.missing-term.message: The search term’s provider may be missing, disabled or incompatible. Check the Add-ons Manager and whether the term is enabled in the provider’s settings.

troubleshooter.explain.mixed-conditions.message: This logic may be intentional. Opening this filter in Thunderbird’s editor may misinterpret its conditions. Inspect the read-only text or disable the filter without changing its conditions. Disabling does not repair the logic.

troubleshooter.explain.no-run-method.message: This filter is enabled, but is not configured to run automatically or manually. Enabling it for incoming mail is an optional change, not an automatic repair.

troubleshooter.explain.unparseable.message: Thunderbird could not parse this filter. Inspect its stored text without opening the filter editor.

troubleshooter.filterChanged.message: This filter changed during review. Rerun the checks.

troubleshooter.filterReplaced.message: This filter was removed or replaced. Rerun the checks.

troubleshooter.filterUnavailable.message: This filter is no longer available. Rerun the checks.

troubleshooter.help.addons.message: Other add-ons can provide custom actions and search terms. You may need to enable them in the add-on’s settings. They can also become unavailable if the add-on is disabled or incompatible with your Thunderbird version.

troubleshooter.help.conditions.message: Thunderbird’s filter editor currently supports matching ALL conditions or ANY condition. Work is underway to support combining both in groups. Your mail client or version may already support this feature.

troubleshooter.help.folders.message: Folders may be moved, deleted or removed on an IMAP server, leaving a filter without a valid destination. Thunderbird usually updates filter rules when you rename or move a folder within the same account.

troubleshooter.help.runs.message: Sometimes filters do not run automatically even when configured to do so. A damaged Thunderbird profile can be one cause. This check looks for missing run settings; it cannot diagnose profile corruption.

troubleshooter.intro.message: Run checks, review problems and decide what to change.

troubleshooter.logHint.message: Investigate recent filter activity for the selected account.

troubleshooter.mailWindowRequired.message: Open a Thunderbird mail window before using the troubleshooter.

troubleshooter.mixedConditionsSupported.message: Your app already supports mixed conditions, so that part of this check is omitted. Missing conditions are still checked.

troubleshooter.mixedEditWarning.message: This filter contains mixed or grouped conditions. Your filter editor may not support them correctly. Opening it could alter them. Continue?

troubleshooter.noAccounts.message: No accounts with filters are available.

troubleshooter.readOnly.message: Checks all problem types. Changes to filters always require your explicit choice.

troubleshooter.reason.no-run-method.message: No way to run this filter configured

troubleshooter.sessionExpired.message: This review session has expired. Reopen the troubleshooter.

troubleshooter.start.message: Run a check to inspect this account’s filters.

troubleshooter.summary.message: Filters needing review: $filters$ · $resolved$ problems resolved · $checks$ of 4 checks run

troubleshooter.tableHint.message: One row per problem. Expand Details for an explanation.

troubleshooter.trialExhausted.message: Your free troubleshooter uses are exhausted. Get quickFilters Pro to run more checks.

troubleshooter.unsafeEditor.message: Opening this filter in the editor is unsafe. View its conditions or disable it instead.
